}

		STP_NonSTP as string,
		Count as string,
		Source as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,

		LoadDate as string,
		Business_Group as string,
		AsofDate as string,
		STP_NonSTP as string,
		Count as string,
		Source as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(

		Business_Group,
		AsofDate,
		STP_NonSTP,
